calendar_authority.A: current captured snapshot only, no inferred historical validity
calendar_authority.B: IANA native session + current spec + actual timestamp boundary checks; tagged proxy, unknown holiday/maintenance/tick-value history retained

components: exit fill-to-recorded-level proxy signed and absolute
calibration.fallback: sparse => no model, no cross-account transfer, no invented full-cost estimate
calibration.model: training arithmetic mean; no tuning; raw median descriptive only
calibration.notional: closing-entry reference price * closed cents/100 * recorded quote/deposit conversion; no assumed historical contract multiplier
calibration.position_boundary: Fee observations whose entry precedes cutoff and exit follows cutoff are retained as boundary exclusions
calibration.scope: retrospective time-ordered component validation, not new independent alpha evidence
calibration.split: earliest 70 percent of distinct UTC observation dates for training; remaining complete dates for held-out verification; global cutoff per component, account/environment/symbol/purpose buckets never pooled
calibration.uncertainty: daily block errors and normal 95-percent interval if >=2 holdout days; explicitly unstable for few blocks

reservation.selection: rank complete 8-symbol 5-day weeks by minimum distinct missing M30 slots, then date; select nonoverlapping weeks without inspecting outcomes
reservation.warmup_reuse: explicit owner-authorised versioned policy permits verified causal preparation reuse; evaluation price paths must not overlap any previously inspected price source, and missing preparation must be unspent
